node.statement: Since I_n tensor I has only the 11 and 22 source corners, gamma_n(I)=gamma_11,n(I_n tensor Pi_1)+gamma_22,n(I_n tensor Pi_2). Applying the two diagonal-unit approximation bounds and the target approximate-complementarity bound, then the triangle inequality, gives ||gamma_n(I)-I||<=3rho (up to replacing 3 by the fixed universal number encoded when all three errors use the common defect bound). Since rho<=e, this is O(e), uniformly in n.
